item.title: 4 Ways the Gospel Can Reduce Stress and Anxiety in Your Daily Life
item.description: Every day comes with personal challenges, needs, and desires. When those inevitabilities aren’t met, we find ourselves becoming anxious, stressed, and frustrated. What if we look at the gospel not just in the context of salvation but to its fullest extent through the life and ministry of Jesus, applying that to our lives every day?I believe there are four key ways the gospel can reduce stress and anxiety in our daily lives:Photo Credit: ©GettyImages/mbolina
